> Mullenweg is the founder of Automattic, the company that owns WordPress,
Tumblr, Pocket Casts, and a host of other popular internet brands and pieces of
software. Mullenweg has faced several controversies over his management of the
company in recent years. > On a company-wide Slack this morning, Automattic
CEO Matt Mullenweg announced he has been put on a paid leave of absence. […] He
continued, writing that Mark Davies, current Automattic Chief Financial Officer,
has “conspired” with Automattic Board of Directors members Ann Dunwoody, Toni
Schneider, and Sue Decker “behind my back and they voted to put me on a paid
leave of absence. I voted against that.”
